# ASII.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v1) with a 12-month target of Rp5,344.0 against Rp4,540.0 (expected total return 26.4%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: holdco_discount_narrowing · method card: per fund record routing for Conglomerates & multi-sector holdings.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- SOTP values all seven divisions with segment-earnings multiples, but the method card requires listed stakes at market value and unlisted parts on their own card. UNTR, AALI, Astra Graphia and MMP are listed, every holdin
- The only valuation input in the primary method, the differentiated 6x to 9x segment multiples, has zero evidence behind it - no segment comps, no trading history, no source in params_basis beyond the earnings facts. Fina
- MSHE is capitalised at 6x FY2025A net income of Rp9,095bn and billed as through-cycle, yet H1-2026 MSHE fell 46pc to Rp2,704bn on the RKAB quota cut with Komatsu units down 27pc. Annualised H1 implies about Rp5.4tn, whic

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
